title: Rust: SenderID field support
description: Implement 10-byte extended SenderID field in Rust
close_reason: Rust SenderID/SIID field support verified complete in rust/lichen-link: LLSec bit 7 (SI) parse+serialize, 8-byte signer EUI-64 after DST, S=1<->SI=1 parity rejection both directions, SIID included in Schnorr-48 transcript (schnorr.rs) and verified via EUI-64->IID toggle against trust store (link_layer.rs). Wire format matches draft-lichen-link-01 sections 3.1-3.4 and canonical test/vectors/link_frame.json (shared_vectors.rs asserts signer_eui64 roundtrip). Fixed one divergence vs Python oracle: frame::write_to accepted unsigned frames carrying a partial (non-empty, non-8) signer_eui64 and silently emitted those bytes without the SI bit; now enforces exactly 8-byte signer iff signed, empty iff unsigned, matching python/src/lichen/link/frame.py; updated FrameError::SignatureSignerMismatch message and added regression test serializer_rejects_partial_signer_on_unsigned_frame. Validated: cargo build -p lichen-link OK; cargo test -p lichen-link --features 'schnorr,std' => 142 unit + all integration suites pass incl shared_vectors; cargo test -p lichen-link --no-default-features --lib => 77 pass; cargo clippy -p lichen-link --features 'schnorr,std' -- -D warnings clean. Note: '10-byte' wording in bead title is stale - current spec defines the field as 8-byte SIID; sibling bead .5 (vectors) closed under the same interpretation.
